Hi team,

Thanks for taking time to interview Alyssa yesterday. I pulled together what I have and would like a rapid alignment so we can decide whether to move to an onsite (final loop) or pause. Quick asks: 

- Please fill the attached scorecard (one line per competency) and return by EOD PT today.
- Drop any short artifacts you captured (system-design notes, links to recordings).
- If you have a strong hire/no-hire lean, include a one-sentence justification.

I attached my partial scorecard and the candidate's resume; Mateo, can you paste your system-design notes if you have them? Karthik / Mina — if you saw any blocking signals, flag them.

Quick add from my side after going through both scorecards and Mateo's notes:

- My scores: Technical depth 3, Design 3, Code 4, Communication 4. Total: 14/20.
- Observable risks: limited exposure to multi-region failover patterns and no prior infra ownership in production LLM serving.
- Mitigations: a focused take-home on routing and a 45-minute follow-up with infra team leads would remove most uncertainty.

Recommendation: proceed to a short follow-up (homework + focused convo) before committing to onsite. If the homework checks out, we should prioritize offering before competitor outreach accelerates.
